reconciliation_records.reconciliation_reason: Initial launch in September 2023 approved 1.065 Crore households. Subsequent appeal review expanded approval to 1.16 Crore households by February 2024.
FY 2023-24 actual expenditure covered 7 months (Sep 2023 - Mar 2024) totaling INR 6,570 Crore. Full annual FY 2024-25 outlay is INR 13,720 Crore.
